verse: tacchṛṇuṣva samāsena sārabhūtaṃ yathā sthitam | yena siddhā mahāsiddhāḥ svacakre cakramadhyagāḥ
melāpe militā sā vai utsarge paramā citiḥ | (9) upasthasya tu madhyagā retovāhe sadoditā
śrībhairavyūvāca śṛṇu sarvaṃ samāsena sṛṣṭicakrasya sarvataḥ | samayāṃpūrayet sadyaḥ bāhyataḥ parameśvara
tithyante mārgārūḍhā sā ūrdhvamārgāvalambinī | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
mūrtayastu mahākāla kāyena manasā girā | paścāt siddhakramaṃ pūjyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam
kaivalyasaṃjña cāmnāyaṃ maraṇā sarvaduḥkhahā | evaṃ sṛṣṭikramaṃ vīra sarvabhāvasthamagrataḥ
sthitipañcamakaṃ nātha saṃhārasaptamairyutam | daśasaptādhikaṃ varṇaṃ viddhi bhairavarūpakam
taṃ namaṃ satupasarvaṃ? ṭhakāraṃ vartulaṃ mahat | kathitaṃ tava deveśa bhāsākhyaṃ tat viduḥ padam
jñātavyā sarvadā kālī kramaṇī parameśvarī | tapasthitipadāntasthā dīrghāmbarāvilambinī
āṇave paramānande mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | antaḥpade sthitā kācid dṛśyādṛśyaistu varjitā
tasmiṃ cakre mahāghore mahāmātṛbhiḥ saṃkule | svavimarśadaśanibhā * * * * * * * *(?)
pañcaprakārametaddhi vijñāyet tattvadarśinaḥ | kramaṃ tu devadeveśa āgataṃ kramayogataḥ
jñānopāsye mahājñāne jñeyarūpe namo'stu te | kriyārūpe mahārūpe viśvarūpe namo'stu te
lakmīyugmaṃ tathā māyā mahāśabdamataḥ param | eṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā viddhi bhairava tattvataḥ
nāsattā na ca sattā vā sattāsattobhayojjhitam | avedyam vedakatve'aapi sākaṃ ko pacanārthataḥ
phalameva prayacchanti kālikājñānamuttamam | etat kramaṃ tu siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ mahātapa
saṃhārakramage nityaṃ sṛṣṭirūpe namastu te | kandasthānagate nityaṃ kauṇḍalyākhye namo'stu te
mahāvṛkṣathavā sthale mahāgire'aathavā punaḥ | mahācatuṣpathe vātha mahānadyāmathāpi vā
yena vijñātamātreṇa bhavāmi kramabhājanaḥ | ke siddhāstasya tattvasya pāramparyavyavasthitāḥ
prāptā tu paramā devyā mahāsiddhipradāstu tāḥ  ||2/19 ||
idānīṃ devi me tathyaṃ tasya cakrasya madhyagā | sthitirūpā parā vidyā kālī kālakṣayaṃkarī
akramakramabhāvena kathayasva yathārthataḥ | śrībhairavyuvāca atyantagahanaṃ guhyaṃ melāpaṃ malavarjitam
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi śāmbhavaṃ * yathāvidhiḥ | mārgeṇa devadevyāstu laharyo jñeyasya * *?
aṭane sarvajantūnāṃ haṭhajñānena khegatā | khaṇḍakhaṇḍakamadhyasthā khaṇḍakākārabhakṣikā
sarvamantra-ārṇavaṃ guhyaṃ sarvavidyālayaṃ param | asya cakreśvarasyaiva sakṛt paśyati yo naraḥ
bindusvabhāvage rasabindvākhye ca namo'stu te | śaktirūpe tu dehasthe sarvāvasthe namo'stu *
śrībhairava uvāca ooṃ namaste devadeveśi mahākāli namo'stu te | namo'stu paramānande nirānande namo'stu te
sthitinavamasaṃyuktaṃ etad varṇaṃ caturthakam | tatastu sthiticakraṃ taṃ daśamaṃ viddhi pañcamam
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāyoginivaktragam | tatastu devadeveśa mahāśabdaṃ samuddharet
melāpena yathā devyo militāstu svabhāvataḥ | dvādaśa ca prayatnena viśvarūpā nirañjanāḥ
sarvamantreṣu tat sāraṃ sarvajñeyeṣu cottamam | sarvopamāmatikrāntaṃ vākkramātītagocaram
pretaiśca kinnaraiḥ sarvai bhīṣaṇaistu mahābalaiḥ | ḍākinī rākinī caiva lākinī kākinī tathā
khakārākṣaramadhyasthā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | eṣā vidyā mahāguhyā sthiticakrasya madhyagā
kiṃ tadbhāvagaṃ bhāvaṃ vā kiṃ vā bhāveṣu madhyagam | kiṃ vā ādyamanādyaṃ vā kiṃ vā ādyantamadhyagam
ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu yad  jñeyaṃ jñānarūpaṃ parāparam ||2/26 ||
yad jñātvā bodhaśālīnāṃ prabuddhānām umādha ca | ? khegatirbhavate sadyaḥ sarvabhāvakṣayaṃkarī
etaccakraṃ tu cakreśaṃ sarvabhāvakṣayaṃkaram | sarvakāmaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasānnidhyakārakam
siddhayoginīdivyaṃ vai kramaṃviddhi samāsataḥ | etat kramaṃ mahāghoraṃ sadyaḥ khegatidāyakam
pūrvāntānāckamadhyasthā tataḥ proktā parā kalā | adhomārge dīrghaśiraṃ ukāraṃ sarvabhakṣakam
na ca bindugataṃ nātha nānodayavivarjitam | na śūnyaṃ na cā śūnyaṃ vā śūnyānāṃ bhayavarjitam
sṛṣṭicakrasya saṃsthānaṃ vidhinā śṛṇu īśvara | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me devadeveśi sthiticakre tu yat kramam
sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ gṛhya saṃhārasaptame yutam | daśamaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam
iti śrīmaduttarapīṭhavinirgate śrīśrīnāthapādāvatārite śrīkālikākramasadbhāve mahārthakramāvatāro nāma tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
mahāvane mahāghore gahane harṣadāyine | mahāhave'aatha bhīme vā vīragrasanalampaṭe
svasvabhāvasamāviṣṭā jñānadāḥ parameśvara | śrībhairava uvāca ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu mūrtināṃ gūḍhaṃ sarvārthanāśanam
na jñānaṃ na ca vijñeyaṃ melāpaṃ paramaṃ na ca | na sṛṣṭirna ca saṃhāraṃ sthitibhāsāvivarjitam
sṛṣṭicakrasya madhyasthā pūjā bhasmavilepanaiḥ | puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca vīradravyaiśca sarvataḥ
aṣṭamasyāvavasthaṃ tu sthitikāranasaṃyutam | navamena śirākrāntaṃ varṇamidaṃ dvitīyakam
saṃhāracakre deveśa trayodaśamamagrataḥ | uddharet tu vidhānena sṛṣṭirdaśamasaṃyutam
rūḍhārūḍhasvabhāvena jñānena samatāṃ gatā | natvāra daśamo raghrā āghrābhā tu na kenacit
